title: xi dats zone_npcs action
description: A zone's NPC list: the names the client shows, in the zone's entity-name table (file id 6720 + zone, the zone model's + 2600 from zone 256), renamed or added by zone-local id, with each new or changed NPC's npc_list row written as proposed SQL beside the project (never run). New NPCs take ids from the custom band 0x380-0x3FF; "auto" picks a free one and a rebuild keeps it. Each name written is recorded per build target: a rebuild converges and undo is exact.

server.description: The proposed SQL for the NPCs' npc_list rows. It is written, never run.

sql.description: Relative to the file holding this action. Default: <project>.sql beside the project file.

result.description: Recorded by dats build: per build target, every name written (entity id, before and after).

name_key.description: An auto NPC: the name its id is kept under.

id.description: The NPC's zone-local id (0x001-0x3FF; the entity id is 0x01000000 | zone << 12 | id), or "auto" for a new NPC: the first free id from 0x380.

name.description: The name the client shows (up to 27 cp932 bytes). On an existing NPC: a rename — the SQL sets polutils_name and leaves npc_list.name, which binds its Lua script.

new.description: Add the NPC: its name goes into the table and its full npc_list row into the SQL.

server.description: npc_list columns: a new NPC's row (model or look required; the rest default to a cutscene-only NPC: status 6, flag 1, speed 50, entityFlags 27), or the columns to change on an existing one. false leaves the server out.

model.description: A fixed model id (monster / entity / object): the look becomes size 0 + this id.

look.description: The 20-byte look blob as hex (an equipped character: race, face and gear).

name.description: npc_list.name (default: the name, spaces as _): the key the server loads the NPC's Lua by.

status.description: 0 normal, 2 disappear, 3 invisible, 6 cutscene only (default: an event shows it).

npcs.name: Wolfgang the Watchful
npcs.note: a title for the gate guard
